corrections.text: The article states that GitHub's Sameen Karim "told DevClass" that "the CLI is completely optional, you can create stacked PRs purely via the UI." The quoted words are accurate and correctly attributed to Karim, but DevClass's April 2026 article sources this quote to a public Hacker News comment Karim posted, not a statement made directly to DevClass. DevClass reported on and linked to that comment; it was not an interview.
